challenges.name: wallet-and-payment-methods
challenges.title: Write the wallet and the payment methods behind one interface
challenges.description: The Cho Xanh checkout charges a PaymentMethod and knows nothing else. Implement Wallet (top-ups and payments with a private setter on the balance) and the three payment methods, cash on delivery, the wallet and a card with a limit, so that every rule lives inside the class that owns the money: no zero or negative amounts, no top-up above 10,000,000 or balance above 20,000,000, no payment above the balance or the card limit, and no cash order above 2,000,000. The test runner reads top-up, pay and balance commands and prints the result of each.

tests.name: Everyday payments with all three methods
tests.input:
wallet 200000 card 1000000
pay wallet 120000
pay cash 85000
pay card 300000
balance
tests.expected:
pay wallet 120000: ok
pay cash 85000: ok
pay card 300000: ok
wallet 80000 VND, card limit 700000 VND

tests.name: Declined when the money is not there
tests.input:
wallet 50000 card 100000
pay wallet 80000
pay card 150000
pay cash 2500000
balance
tests.expected:
pay wallet 80000: declined
pay card 150000: declined
pay cash 2500000: declined
wallet 50000 VND, card limit 100000 VND

tests.name: Top-ups and their limits
tests.input:

topup 12000000
